target.statement: Final clustering accuracy of DGC-KM on Iris (homogeneous, m=10 ring, K=3, rho=10, T=1000) with random initialization, averaged over 5 runs and across users (Figure 2/3 baseline point).
target.dataset: Iris (150 samples, d=4, K=3), split across 10 users

compute.basis: Tiny dataset (150x4) and 1000 iterations of a simple consensus+gradient K-means loop over 10 users; the only real work is re-implementing Algorithm 1 and the homogeneous/heterogeneous splits from the text, which is quick.

blockers: No code released; DGC-KM update rule and exact data-splitting scheme must be re-implemented from the paper
Exact accuracy values are only in figures, so the reproduced number can only be compared approximately
title: Distributed Gradient Clustering: Convergence and the Effect of Initialization
